package.name: de4sdv_score_adapter
package.description: DE4SDV AutowareToSCORE adapter of INC-MW-011: one process that is an Eclipse S-CORE communication (mw::com) application and a ROS 2 node. It receives the reference vehicle speed as an mw::com proxy and publishes each finite sample once as an Autoware VelocityReport on /de4sdv/middleware/velocity_status, and it forwards the length-delimited AEBS signal frames of 127.0.0.1:4721 unchanged as an mw::com event. It links baselibs' aborts_upon_exception, so every exception in the process aborts it. The S-CORE part comes as static archives from a Bazel build of the S-CORE SOME/IP gateway workspace; the pure core builds and tests without S-CORE and ROS 2.
